dedupe_keys.name: citygml energy ade application domain extension for urban energy simulation version 1 0 with later 2 0 and 3 0 developments

description: The CityGML Energy ADE is an application domain extension that adds to the CityGML 3D city model standard the features and properties needed to run urban energy simulations and store their results. The CityGML wiki page read on 2026-09-28 gives version 1.0 of February 2018 for CityGML 2.0 as the released version, with the XML schema, UML diagrams, a specification PDF, an online feature catalogue, a Karlsruhe Institute of Technology profile and sample files, and names the SIG 3D working group contacts. It cites the 2018 paper by Agugiaro and colleagues on interoperability for urban energy simulation, and notes a version 2.0 from 2019 and a version 3.0 in development. Coverage is not geographic: it is a data model applicable to any city. Access to the schema and documents is free; no licence is stated on the wiki page. Caveats: the released version targets CityGML 2.0, tools support it unevenly, and the later versions were not read. It supports digital twin and planning studies, such as encoding building constructions, usage zones and heating systems of a 3D city model as input to a district heating or retrofit simulation. Related records: the CityGML Utility Network ADE and the CityJSON encoding.
